description: This file defines the TextureRenderer class responsible for rendering textures on an OpenGL surface within an Android application. It includes shader code, OpenGL setup, and rendering logic.

classes.name: TextureRenderer
classes.description: A class for rendering textures onto a surface with scaling and aspect ratio adjustments.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes shader program and allocates buffers.

methods.name: updateTextureSize
methods.description: Updates internal texture dimensions and recomputes output vertices.

methods.name: updateViewSize
methods.description: Updates view dimensions and recomputes output vertices.

methods.name: renderTexture
methods.description: Renders a given texture ID onto the surface.

methods.name: computeOutputVertices
methods.description: Calculates vertex positions to maintain aspect ratio based on texture and view sizes.
